title: Invalid slope caliberation + connection at night + question
symptom: User reports being unable to calibrate in xDrip; calibration attempts revert without success. Also, at night (when sleeping), xDrip loses connection for 100-200 minutes each night, while the Dexcom receiver works fine.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. Possible causes mentioned include phone 'sleeping' (battery optimization) and user behaviors with G6 calibration, but no confirmed cause.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Suggestions include excluding xDrip from battery optimization, and for calibration, limiting corrections to 20% of the reading and avoiding frequent calibrations, but these are recommendations, not confirmed resolutions.
evidence_quote: You should never calibrate a CGM if your trend is not flat or very close to flat. If you restart a G6, using the original calibration code, you will interfere with factory calibration mechanism of G6. The result is that after the 2-hour warm-up, you will experience a significant error. The readings will be much higher than they should be. To calibrate, you need to limit the calibration to small values. The recommendation is to limit the correction to 20% of the reading.
